notes.title: Физика и превозмогание: Обзор Bionic Bay
notes.content: Этой загруженной весной финско-китайский дуэт под крылом Kepler Interactive практически незаметно выпустил одно из самых стильных и увлекательных приключений 2025 года. Bionic Bay рассказывает о неудачном эксперименте с инопланетным артефактом, который приводит к глобальной катастрофе в научном комплексе.

notes.title: Patch Notes - May 5th, 2025 (v1.3.5.2)
notes.content:
• Fixed an issue where the leaderboard displayed incorrectly the first time during special online levels.  
• Fixed a bug that caused incorrect leaderboard rankings under specific conditions after uploading a score in special online levels.  
• Fixed boundary issues and oversized checkpoints in some levels.  
• Removed the countdown timer display in special online levels.

By the way, the special level [b]Shuhei's Gauntlet[/b] is now live! Beat [i]Shuhei Yoshida[/i]’s record to unlock his exclusive outfit!

notes.title: Get Your Running Shus On
notes.content:
Speedrunning Scientists! Alongside our little polishing update today, we’re thrilled to let you know that our Shuhei Yoshida skin is now live in Bionic Bay Online!

To bring Shuhei into your online speedrunning, all you have to do is beat his time in our specially-crafted course. If you manage to beat this PlayStation legend’s best time, you’ll be able to jump in as Shu on both PC and PlayStation 5

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42461060/84dd08c4f9ef9b3672be135a940f8474d876246e.gif[/img]

We’ve been so honoured to collaborate with Shuhei, and incredibly proud that Bionic Bay has lived up to his high expectations. What better way to celebrate such an incredible PlayStation icon, than to throw him into our dangerous bio-mechanical world.

You can jump into Bionic Bay Online right now, to test out Shuhei's Gauntlet and see if you can best his time. Unlike our other speedrunning challenges, this one will remain open, to allow all players the chance of dressing up in Shu’s pink shirt.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42461060/ee79662468a210ae3c80caa28dfc07c8fec95dc5.gif[/img]

There's no better time to get into Bionic Bay Online's speedrunning courses. In this mode, intrepid scientists can compete to set times against a constantly-changing online leaderboard. With the exception of Shuhei's Gauntlet, each course runs for a limited time, before allocating points to your global profile.

What better chance for glory? Get into our research program now, set a time and show Shuhei how he should have done it.

notes.title: Bionic Bay is Available Now!
notes.content:
Speed running scientists and challenge hunters, rejoice. After years of crafting, your invitation to Bionic Bay is now available on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1928690/Bionic_Bay/]Steam[/url].

It began with a chance meeting on Reddit, and now the Bionic Bay story continues with you, our trusted Research Participants. In Bionic Bay you’ll master the art of teleportation, control the very fabric of time itself, manipulate gravity and navigate a path filled with dangers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42461060/5abab51b647001f813b3419b1146708288d8d69b.gif[/img]

Our team will provide you with the tools you’ll need to traverse this intricately crafted pixel art world. But don’t let the stunning visuals fool you, this is no slow-moving narrative crawl. The best way to navigate Bionic Bay is with fast movements, precise controls, exceptional timing, puzzle solving intuition and just maybe a little bit of luck.

What you’ve seen in the Bionic Bay demo is just the beginning. Bionic Bay v1.0 includes 23 painstakingly created levels, with an increasing challenge to simply stay alive through your journey. Importantly, however, the path can be as helpful as it is dangerous, and Research Participants will need to judge the way ahead accordingly.

In addition to the main game, we’ve also developed the Bionic Bay Online mode, with a dedicated build for speed runners and those hungry for a challenge. In this demanding arena, you’ll have the opportunity to customise your own scientist, and claim your place on our transient and global leaderboards.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42461060/2ee78fda26e7bb0f09b287b1e109b4506e210105.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42461060/2ee78fda26e7bb0f09b287b1e109b4506e210105.gif[/img][/url]

Bionic Bay’s data-ghost racing reflects age-old racing titles, and provides a consistently refreshing challenge for those looking for a little more. While each course lasts for a limited time, placing on here will deliver points against your profile on our global leaderboard. Perform well, and claim speedrunning glory, mastering all of the tools that Bionic Bay offers!

Bionic Bay is available NOW It’s time to take science into your own hands. Good luck, Research Participants!

notes.title: Bionic Bay (PC) Review
notes.content:
For some reason, I’ve been thinking a lot about classic platformers lately — and what made them good. When it comes to the lifespan of this hobby, they’re pretty important. Many people can trace their earliest forays into gaming to a pivotal platformer. Whether it’s Super Mario, Banjo-Kazooie or even Bubsy, it usually comes down to the movement. The best platformers always—through some combination of sound, visuals and sheer feeling—make the basic act of navigating their world fun. That said, Bionic Bay has some really fun movement.

“Bionic Bay has some really fun movement.”

It’s not your typical movement, though. Sure, Bionic Bay gets the essentials out of the way early. The first level functions as an expanded tutorial on how the game handles momentum and air dashes—so much so that the powerful “roll, jump, air dash” combo becomes second nature. Players are quickly thrust into complex platforming and puzzle challenges that demand some real outside-the-box thinking.... Read more

notes.title: All New Trailer and Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
It’s time for science! Research Participants who have been keeping up with the Future Games Show may have seen that we have released a new trailer and a new demo. You can head over to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1928690/Bionic_Bay/]Steam[/url] to try out our updated research sample, which now includes the new Bionic Bay Online mode!

[previewyoutube=jiN-RcwErlo;full][/previewyoutube]
Since we last invited Research Participants to experience Bionic Bay, the team have been working on new tweaks, polishes and adding in a number of deathtraps clever puzzles. While the new Bionic Bay Online mode is undoubtedly the star of the show, Research Participants will find a lot more to be getting along with.

In Bionic Bay Online, research Participants will race through an area prepped with a significant number of hazards and obstacles. You’ll need to use all of the tools at your disposal to set the best time you can, including swap mechanics, gravity shift and the ChronoLag™ time dilation features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42461060/2ee78fda26e7bb0f09b287b1e109b4506e210105.gif[/img]

We’re inviting Research Participants into the new Bionic Bay demo right now, so head over to Steam and jump in for yourself. Set a time in the Bionic Bay Online Leaderboards, challenge your friends and compete against your fellow research participants. You can also head to the [url=https://discord.gg/A8pXbEqv2g]official Bionic Bay Discord[/url] to help, hints and hectic friends to race against.

notes.title: Time to slow things down
notes.content:
Research Participants! Somebody who shall remain unnamed (KEVIN) has been left unattended with Bionic Bay’s ChronoLag time dilation technology. Because of this unnamed person (STILL KEVIN) we’ll be releasing Bionic Bay with a slight delay to April 17th 2025. 

However, in the meantime, we’ll be inviting Research Participants to dive into Bionic Bay with a new Steam demo (coming soon), including pulse-pounding racing with Bionic Bay Online’s friends and global leaderboards for PC players.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42461060/d84c232c52a87c102f0d5747258a396ced807d63.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42461060/d84c232c52a87c102f0d5747258a396ced807d63.gif[/img][/url]

In addition, to help you face the coming dangers, we’ll also be introducing a series of informative videos - Welcome to Bionic Bay. In this series we’ll have an in-depth look at the potential challenges Research Participants will face, and the tools you’ll find to help you face them.

The brand-new Bionic Bay demo will be available on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1928690/Bionic_Bay/]Steam[/url] soon, where players should wishlist now to keep up with news and dev updates. You can also subscribe on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@juupelitin]YouTube[/url] to find the upcoming Welcome to Bionic Bay series.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42461060/2ee78fda26e7bb0f09b287b1e109b4506e210105.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42461060/2ee78fda26e7bb0f09b287b1e109b4506e210105.gif[/img][/url]

We’re excited for you to open the doors to Bionic Bay. In the meantime, please do [strike]blame Kevin[/strike] check out the updated demo and stick with us for more insights, coming soon.
